name: Yuragi Douraku
source:
A magical warrior engages in neverending conflict with a ghost.
She is taken hostage and her pride is pounded into submission.
In such a situation, is there any way out?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE062015.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位魔法战士与幽灵展开了无休止的争斗。
她遭到俘虏，骄傲也在一次次打击下屈服。
身陷如此境地，她还能找到出路吗？！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE062015.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
